Title: Azure IoT Edge 1.0.9 release is now available

Body.Content:
The 1.0.9 version of Azure IoT Edge includes the following improvements below. Full release notes can be found on the GitHub release page for 1.0.9.

  • Ability to provision an IoT Edge's device identity with a x.509 cert via the Device Provisioning Service (DPS)
  • Easily collect logs needed to investigate issues on an IoT Edge device with the new command 'iotedge support-bundle'
  • Multiple connectivity bug fixes.

Instructions on how to update IoT Edge can be found here.
